svg.title: Planned development and verification toolchain — verification pipeline
svg.desc: Five-stage verification pipeline: Smart Contract Development, Foundry Fuzz Tests, Certora CVL Reserve Proofs, CI Pipeline, and Testnet Deployment.
svg.text: Verification is progressively strengthened from testing to formal proofs, then continuously enforced in CI
before final deployment to Polygon zkEVM Cardona testnet in Phase IV.
